About > About the College > Overview
The College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence is the youngest college at United Arab Emirates University (UAEU). It was established in 2001 and has earned a reputation for excellence in research, teaching and community service. The CIT employs an outstanding team of faculty members who are Doctoral degree holders and are internationally recognized for their contribution to research, innovation and education. In addition, a team of Master’s degree qualified staff who are recognized for their industrial and technical experience are responsible for handling the hand-on education portion of the offered programs utilizing the state-of-the-art laboratories and classrooms hosted by the CIT. To support students and faculty, a team of dedicated administrative staff is employed. This team makes it possible for students and faculty to have a wonderful experience at College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence .

The CIT is a world-class, student-centered place that develops and delivers Computing programs which hold international accreditation and are recognized globally for their rigorous academic standards and relevance to contemporary professional practices. All offered undergraduate and graduate programs at the CIT are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA) of the UAE Ministry of Education. The Bachelor of Science Programs in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security and Information Technology are accredited by ABET (Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology).

CIT is committed to producing graduates with technical proficiency, theoretical and experiential knowledge required in computing disciplines such as: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Information and Cybersecurity and Information Technology.

Graduates of the CIT are employed in government and industry positions that serve the needs of the nation and contribute to advances in Computing and related fields in the UAE and wider region. CIT students are involved in undergraduate research and have presented at international conferences and published articles in major research journals. Many choose to pursue their graduate studies and obtain Master or Doctoral degrees.

About > About the College > Dean's Message
The College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence is a vibrant community where students, faculty, and staff come together to provide excellence in learning, research, innovation, and service.

Our students and alumni continually make us proud through their outstanding achievements and meaningful contributions both in the UAE and across the globe. They consistently demonstrate academic excellence, creativity, and leadership by participating in prestigious national and international conferences, publishing in top-ranked journals, winning renowned competitions, and securing patents for their innovations.

Our faculty members are at the forefront of modern teaching and learning methodologies, while also conducting groundbreaking research that is regularly published in leading international scientific venues.

Our well-designed curricula are infused with Artificial Intelligence and cater for the growing needs of our great and beloved nation in Computing fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Computer Engineering and Information and Cybersecurity.

I warmly invite you to explore our website and to visit our campus. Experience our state-of-the-art facilities and laboratories, witness our advanced teaching technologies, and meet our motivated students, accomplished faculty, and dedicated staff, who together exemplify the spirit and vision of CCAI.

Prof. David Camacho Fernandez

Dean, College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence

About > About the College > Accreditation
All undergraduate and graduate programs offered by the College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence (CIT) are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA) of UAE Ministry of Education.

The BSc in Information Technology, the BSc in Computer Science and the BSc in Information Security programs in the CIT at the United Arab Emirates University is accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET . In addition, the BSc in Computer Engineering program is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET.

ABET accreditation provides assurance that a program meets the quality standards of the profession for which that program prepares graduates.

About CAA

The Commission for Academic Accreditation ( CAA ) is the UAE Federal Government Quality Assurance Agency for Higher Education. Working collaboratively with relevant international and local authorities in the Emirates, the CAA has a key leadership role in securing and developing the quality of higher education in the UAE. As a matter of the highest priority, it sets out to safeguard academic standards, and to assure and enhance the quality of learning opportunities provided for students in UAE’s higher education institutions (HEIs). It undertakes licensure of HEIs in the UAE and accreditation of their award-bearing academic programs. In order to be entered in the National Register and receive Federal Recognition any HEIs offering post-secondary education in the UAE must receive institutional licensure and accreditation of their degree, diploma and certificate programs that are of at least one-year study duration. CAA accreditation incorporates recognition of Higher Diploma (Advanced Diploma) Bachelor Degree, Postgraduate Diploma and Certificate, Master Degree and Doctorate Degree. These Degree ranges from level 6-8 as per National Qualifications Framework (QFEmirates) of UAE ​

About ABET

ABET is a nonprofit, non-governmental agency that accredits programs in applied and natural science, computing, engineering and engineering technology. ABET accreditation provides assurance that a college or university program meets the quality standards of the profession for which that program prepares graduates. ABET accredit programs, not institutions and provides specialized accreditation for post-secondary programs within degree-granting institutions already recognized by national or regional institutional accreditation agencies or national education authorities worldwide. ABET accreditation is voluntary, and to date, 4,773 programs at 930 colleges and universities in 42 countries have received ABET accreditation. Over 200,000 students graduate from ABET-accredited programs each year, and millions of graduates have received degrees from ABET-accredited programs since 1932.

About > About the College > Facilities
The CIT is housed in the excellent College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence building, and has embarked on an ambitious project to deliver laboratory education of an unprecedented breadth and depth. The CIT boasts some of the most up-to-date laboratories in the world. There are twenty specialized laboratories for Robotics and Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Security and Privacy, and Drones. We also have laboratories specializing in the Internet of Things (IoT), Communication Networks, Grid and Cloud Computing, Digital Hardware and Circuit Design, VLSI, and Immersive Learning.

About > About the College > Community Service
The College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence has established three recurrent innovative activities that contribute to the development of the local community. These include:

IT Marathon Competition

IT Innovations Conference

Cisco Academy

IT Marathon is an annual event run by CIT to nurture and further develop the youth’s enthusiasm for information technology. Over 400 school pupils representing more than 70 schools nationwide in the UAE have been regularly taking part in the IT Marathon’s annual competition since 2008. The event also includes interaction with school teachers to bridge the gap between the education system and to share knowledge about contemporary IT topics.

CIT has also been organizing the annual international conference on Innovations in Information Technology since 2004. This conference brings together eminent research scientists and prominent professionals from the IT industry to discuss with the wider local community some of the contemporary developments which are at the forefront of information technology, and their applications to better serve the local economy and society.

The Cisco Academy at CIT offers students an opportunity to prepare for the CCNA industrial examination by offering the CCNA exploration and discovery course modules. Interested students from UAEU can take the course free of charge to strengthen their career prospects. These courses can also be offered to members of the larger community to train and certify the networking workforce in various organizations.

A student may be awarded only one scholarship and cannot combine more than one scholarship.

DESCRIPTION: Critical sectors of the economy and whole fields of inquiry have been transformed, as the availability of data at unprecedented scale has made it possible to solve daunting problems, that were previously inaccessible. This data revolution has fueled a meteoric rise in the demand for data scientists, with advanced analytical skills, who can transform data into knowledge and business insights. The Mathematics of Data Science program is designed to address the increasing talent gap in data science and train the next generation of highly skilled data scientists with the knowledge and domain expertise needed to thrive in a data-driven economy. The Mathematics of Data Science program will be hosted by the Department of Mathematical Sciences, COS. The program emphasizes the integration of the three pillars of data science – computational, and mathematical thinking – into a cohesive transdisciplinary course of study and internship experience in data analytics. The gained knowledge will introduce students to the concepts, tools, and methods to collect, process, and analyze data. Students will develop the ability to uncover hidden patterns and gain useful insights to solve real-world problems. The emphasis on developing and solving real-world problems in the relevant domain, two distinctive features of the program, will enable students to gain a comprehensive and fully integrated literacy in the foundational areas of data science and artificial intelligence and develop expertise in their domain of interest. Armed with these skills, students will develop the ability to use data and methodically connect theory to problems in hand to derive effective solutions to these problems in the context of the domain under consideration. Although a large demand for data science skills comes from high-tech companies, recent reports show that sectors other than technology are facing a noticeable shortage of skilled data scientists. The graduates of the program will gain the core skills and domain expertise to successfully compete for leading-edge jobs in all sectors of the economy. (1 Credit Hour “CH” is equivalent to 2 ECTS Credit Hours “European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System”).

DESCRIPTION: Data and artificial intelligence are driving transformative changes across every sector of the economy, unlocking new possibilities for solving complex challenges. The interdisciplinary BS in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) program is designed to prepare students for this data-driven, AI-enhanced world by integrating the three pillars of data science computational, mathematical, and statistical thinking with a strong foundation in AI. This cohesive, transdisciplinary curriculum, coupled with immersive internship experiences, equips students with a comprehensive understanding of data science and AI concepts, tools, and methods.(1 Credit Hour “CH” is equivalent to 2 ECTS Credit Hours “European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System”). The program places a strong emphasis on data science and AI, from foundational theories to advanced applications in machine learning, data mining, and predictive analytics. Students will learn to harness AI to uncover hidden patterns within data, enabling them to derive actionable insights and develop innovative solutions to real-world problems. This focus on AI, combined with a practical, hands-on approach, ensures that students develop a robust skill set to thrive in the rapidly evolving fields of data science and AI. By bridging theory and practice, the BS DSAI program enables students to gain mastery not only in data analysis but also in AI techniques such as machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. These skills are critical for success in high-demand roles across industries. The program’s unique emphasis on interdisciplinarity and real-world problem-solving prepares students for the expanding range of opportunities in data science and AI. The rise of AI has fueled an explosive demand for professionals skilled in both data science and AI. While high-tech companies are at the forefront of this demand, sectors beyond technology including healthcare, finance, and government are increasingly seeking AI-savvy data scientists. In alignment with the UAE’s digital transformation goals, the BS DSAI program addresses this critical need, equipping graduates with the skills necessary to excel in a knowledge and AI-driven economy. Graduates of the DSAI program will emerge as well-rounded professionals, capable of leveraging both data science and AI to drive innovation and solve complex problems. With these advanced skills, they will be prepared to take on leading-edge roles in data science, AI, and data analytics across diverse industries and sectors globally.
